response.overview: Eddie (20s) is a modern-day hermit who lives in a remote mountain bothy.  Once a month, he cycles to the valley bottom where he fears his father is dying of loneliness.  A Filmmaker joins Eddie on this journey, capturing the beauty of the moorland landscape and conducting interviews along the way. Gradually, he learns that beneath Eddie’s cheerful facade and confident words, lies a young man who’s struggling to hold himself together.
response.title: Spokes
